name: prahari-evasive-v1
description: Phase-6 adaptive-attacker campaign: the same attacks as dataset.json, re-parameterised to evade the signals they can see. It is the runnable counterpart to the robustness ablation (docs/results/robustness-phase6.md) — the ablation predicts which attacks survive; running this campaign and scoring it falsifies or confirms that prediction on live traffic. Benign rate is raised to 8/s as cover traffic. 'note' on each step records which evasion it encodes; the runner ignores it.

steps.note: low_and_slow: registration storm paced to 8/s, under the benign-calibrated rate floor
spoof_known_gnb: claim gNB id 1 (the real base station) instead of 0xBAD
low_and_slow: establishment flood paced to 10/s to stay inside benign window shape
target_valid_sessions: scan only the low, live SEID range the core actually assigns
low_and_slow: unknown-operation probe paced to 6/s (still an unknown op -> irreducible signal)
spoof_known_gnb + low_and_slow: forged UE context release from the trusted gNB id, paced
